posts.cooked:
Hey guys,

So now we know that there is an errata pack coming with corrections to cards affected by "Ruling 15" which we will be able to order from GTG for just the cost of shipping (plus $0.01).  I also know some people are concerned about incurring shipping costs for such a small item (I believe GTG uses FedEx for their shipping and goes by their prices). So I am offering this:

I will order a bunch of copies of the errata pack, let's say 20, and mail them out to any forumite in the US through USPS in a small enevelope for free. The cards will be packed between two cardboard pieces for protection... but I will not make any guarantees as to their safe arrival to you (though I will pack them as well as I can). I have access to packing materials and more stamps than I will ever use in my life so it'll be easy for me to send them out once I get them. 

So just add your name to the list below by quoting the last post on this thread and putting your forum name on the next available empty space. The list will close for now at 20 and we can resolve any repeats or conflicts via PM.
